members.claim: In edit mode, if `onUpdate` isn't provided (it's optional in the props), submitting silently falls through to `onAdd(form)`. That creates a duplicate item, with a new id, instead of updating the existing one. Edit mode should require `onUpdate` (make it required whenever `editItem` is set, or don't fall back to add), so a wiring mistake can't duplicate data.
